name: Field feedback loop
summary: Opt-in, off-by-default feedback loop that turns the userbase into the fleet: users label findings true/false-positive and anonymous heuristic fingerprints are pushed to a write-only sink, so the real-world false-positive rate can be measured. Egress-only by design.
targetWindow: Client complete; live measurement pending an author-operated endpoint + userbase
updateSource: SDD execution of the feedback-loop plan

required.title: internal/feedback: anonymous capture + write-only transport
required.summary: Minimize (deterministic anonymous scrub with public-identity gating), Capture (nonce + detail=full opt-in), local Store (fingerprint dedup + sent-tracking), three-way consent Config (off/ask/always), and a write-only Transmitter (file + http) that only ever sends.

required.title: Egress-only invariant enforced in CI
required.summary: The feedback path is push-only at three layers: the Transmitter type returns only error; the HTTP impl reads status only and discards the body without decoding; the tool never fetches config/allowlists/updates. TestEgressOnly flags any non-test file that both reads a response body and decodes — catching the two-step read-then-unmarshal idiom, not just an inline decode.

required.title: TUI g/b labeling + counterspy feedback + consent-gated submission
required.summary: TUI g/b keys label findings through the Actor seam (internal/tui still imports only internal/model); cliActor persists labels under the invoking user's home (SUDO_USER-aware); end-of-session submission honors off/ask/always and never loses records on a failed send; counterspy feedback list|submit for non-TUI use.

deferred.title: Stand up the push-only ingest endpoint
deferred.summary: A ~30-line Cloudflare Worker (POST-only) + GitHub transparency mirror; the client ships against a config'd URL.
deferred.reason: Author-owned operational prerequisite outside the code change; the client is fully buildable/testable now via the file transmitter, so infra can follow without blocking the release. Live false-positive measurement depends on it plus a userbase.

outOfScope.title: v0.4.0 privacy egress monitor
outOfScope.summary: Live tracking of what certified/legitimate apps actually send ('trusted, but here's what it exfiltrates — do you consent?'). A distinct subsystem (per-process network observation, destination/volume tracking, consent deltas) recorded in roadmap.json for the next milestone.

workstreams.name: Field feedback loop
workstreams.summary: Anonymous, opt-in, egress-only feedback so the false-positive rate can be measured from the field. Client complete and reviewed; live data collection pending the endpoint + userbase.

blockers.title: Field false-positive rate not yet measured
blockers.summary: MITIGATED by mechanism: the v0.2.0 public-readiness blocker (unmeasured false-positive rate on a single test Mac) now has a userbase-as-fleet measurement path. Fully closing it still requires operating the ingest endpoint and collecting labels from real users — so the blocker is de-risked, not yet resolved.
blockers.nextAction: Stand up the POST-only Worker, ship v0.3.0 to a handful of users with sharing opted in, and review the aggregated false-positive fingerprints.
evidenceNeeded: Community allowlist of confirmed public false positives
